corrections.finding: Body Smart Topology face lacks definition and snake crown has duplicated/blunt strands; tail sweeps too far sideways in front view.
corrections.change: Obtain dedicated HD head geometry; fit body tail toward native rear direction locally before rigging.

corrections.finding: Headless body texture upload against whole-character references displaced armor; inner shoulder caps protruded under the arm seams.
corrections.change: Use the full silhouette upload with Meshy UVs; preserve the separate head set. Tuck 174 inner arm-root vertices and blend them to the chest.
corrections.status: resolved; body v2 and all-clip reduced-mesh deformation review passed

corrections.finding: Palette mask recoloured small hip markings as armour in B/C.
corrections.change: Restrict the armour region to the fitted bodice boundary.
corrections.status: resolved; final B/C closeups and native three-tier captures reviewed

corrections.finding: Tier B/C bindings omitted the required scale field.
corrections.change: Include scale 90.1 alongside scale_reference, matching existing binding schema.

corrections.finding: User requested stronger tail/body slither, gaze attack anticipation/release and evaluation of triangle savings.
corrections.change: Walk/Running travelling tail wave increased; torso/head lean back before the shared Attack/Cast gaze release, then recover. Retained 14900 triangles because 9983/11919/12260/13856 trials visibly degraded textures or silhouette.

corrections.finding: User found straight backward/forward Attack too bland and requested sideways preparation and release follow-through.
corrections.change: Added lateral upper-serpent coil and distributed shoulder twist during preparation, opposing sweep peaking after the gaze release, and neck/head counter-turn. Cast shares this motion.

corrections.finding: User requested bigger backward/forward sway and hand movement.
corrections.change: Increased body pitch and lateral arc, added staggered left/right hand gathering and outward/forward release with wrist rotation and finger opening; shared by Attack/Cast.

rig.route: Local hybrid, measured serpent curve and source-frame humanoid upper body

animations.visual_review: Larger backward/forward and sideways body arc. Bent elbows draw hands up/back during windup; hands sweep forward/outward and open at release with staggered left/right timing, wrist rotation and finger curl. Hands remain clear of face and torso; no observed shoulder collapse, palm/finger deformation or ground penetration.

user_acceptance.feedback: More tail/body wave in Walk/Running; anticipate backward then lean forward for gaze release; Cast may use the same motion. Assess reduced triangles without visible quality loss.
user_acceptance.feedback_v3: Preparation should also shift sideways, with follow-through on release; current motion feels too bland.
user_acceptance.feedback_v4: Make back-to-forward sway bigger and involve hands.
